texts: Most cases of postoperative complete AV block are temporary: C.
Swelling, bleeding or stitches near the conduction tissue can block it after repairs near the AV node; as the swelling settles, conduction usually returns within 7 to 10 days.
Temporary pacing wires bridge the gap, and a permanent pacemaker is needed only if conduction has not returned by then.

Arrhythmias after congenital heart surgery are common, well over 10 percent; junctional ectopic tachycardia typically starts within the first 24 h, and ventricular tachycardia is a wide-complex rhythm.
A long aortic cross-clamp time is a risk factor.
In the picture, the raised drawbridge comes down again after a few days, while the drummer keeps the beat.
